component.name: Mithrandir-RS
component.summary: Blazing-fast Linux system cleaner, real-time hardware telemetry, and AI diagnostics in Rust

description.p: Mithrandir-RS is a high-performance system maintenance suite, cleaner, and diagnostic toolkit rewritten entirely in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita. It delivers instantaneous cleanup scans, deep cache pruning, and granular control over startup services and system processes without background resource overhead.

Designed with a focus on safety and transparency, Mithrandir-RS protects critical operating system paths, features a quarantined ClamAV vault, and runs diagnostic telemetry off the main UI thread for completely stutter-free operation.

ul.li: High-Throughput Cleaner: Multi-threaded cleanup for package caches, thumbnails, application logs, and Flatpak runtimes
Zero-Sleep Real-Time Telemetry: Instant CPU delta calculation, dual GPU metrics, and battery health reporting
Debounced Smart Boost: Safe one-click memory optimization and temporary file reclamation
Quarantine Vault: Integrated ClamAV scanning with secure isolation for flagged files
Integrated Mini-LLM Manager: One-click download and execution of local GGUF models via llama.cpp or Ollama
Dual AI Diagnostics: Real-time diagnostic assistance powered by local offline models or Google Gemini and Claude APIs

description.p: Release v0.4.1 with native Google Gemini AI Studio and Anthropic Claude support.
Initial stable Rust release with GTK4/Libadwaita UI, async telemetry, and local AI manager.
